history.historicalImportance: Gopalganj has historical significance as part of the ancient Kosala and later medieval kingdoms. It is also known as the birthplace of Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the first President of India.
history.formationHistory: Gopalganj district was carved out of Saran district on 2 October 1973 to improve administrative efficiency.
history.freedomMovement: The district actively participated in the Indian freedom movement, especially during the Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement and Quit India Movement.
history.archaeologicalImportance: The district contains several historical temples, old forts, archaeological mounds and ancient religious sites reflecting its rich cultural heritage.
historicalTimeline: Ancient period – Part of the Kosala region and later various Indian kingdoms
Medieval period – Ruled by the Delhi Sultanate and Mughal Empire
1857 – Residents participated in the First War of Independence
2 October 1973 – Gopalganj district was formed from Saran district
Present – Important agricultural district of Bihar

geography.location: Gopalganj district is located in the north-western part of Bihar, near the Uttar Pradesh border, in the Saran Division.
geography.climate: Humid subtropical climate with hot summers, monsoon rains and cool winters

specialEconomicFeatures: Major producer of sugarcane, paddy and maize
Growing dairy and food processing sector

agriculture.dairyDevelopment: Dairy farming is an important source of income, supported by milk cooperative societies and private dairies.
agriculture.fisheries: Fish farming is practiced in ponds, oxbow lakes and other inland water bodies.

infrastructure.roadNetwork: Gopalganj has a well-developed road network connecting all blocks with major cities of Bihar and neighboring Uttar Pradesh.
infrastructure.airConnectivity: The nearest airport is Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna. Kushinagar International Airport (Uttar Pradesh) is also relatively nearby.
infrastructure.publicTransport: Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC), private buses, taxis and auto-rickshaws provide public transport.
infrastructure.electricity: Most urban and rural areas have access to electricity under the Bihar power distribution network.
infrastructure.waterSupply: Urban areas receive piped water supply, while rural areas depend on hand pumps, tube wells and government water supply schemes.
infrastructure.internetConnectivity: 4G and 5G mobile services are available in most parts of the district, along with broadband internet.

education.governmentSchools: More than 2,500 government schools operate across the district.
education.privateSchools: Several CBSE, ICSE and Bihar Board affiliated private schools are located in Gopalganj district.
medicalColleges: No Government Medical College in the district

healthcare.primaryHealthCentres: Primary Health Centres (PHCs) are functioning across all blocks of the district.
medicalColleges: No Government Medical College in the district
healthcare.ambulanceServices: 102 and 108 ambulance services are available throughout the district.

cultureAndHeritage.traditionalDress: Men traditionally wear Dhoti-Kurta and women wear Saree and Salwar-Kameez.
culturalOrganizations: District Art and Culture Office, Gopalganj
Bihar Department of Art, Culture and Youth

sportsAcademies: Bihar State Sports Authority Training Centre
sportsAchievements: District athletes regularly participate in Bihar state-level competitions
School and college teams represent Gopalganj in regional tournaments
Growing participation in cricket, football and kabaddi

bankingAndFinance.atms: ATMs of major public sector and private banks are available across the district.
bankingAndFinance.digitalBanking: UPI, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking and Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS) services are widely available.
financialInclusionPrograms: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

governanceAndPublicServices.districtAdministration: Gopalganj district is administered by the District Magistrate with support from various government departments.
governanceAndPublicServices.policeAdministration: Law and order is maintained by Gopalganj Police under the Bihar Police.
governanceAndPublicServices.fireServices: Fire stations operate in Gopalganj town and other major urban centres.
governanceAndPublicServices.publicDistributionSystem: Essential commodities are distributed through the Public Distribution System (PDS).
eGovernanceServices: Bihar Right to Public Services Portal

lawAndOrder.trafficPolice: Traffic Police regulate traffic in Gopalganj town and major highways.
lawAndOrder.disasterManagement: The District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA), Gopalganj coordinates flood management, disaster preparedness and emergency response.

environment.forestCover: Forest cover is limited, mainly along the Gandak river basin and scattered plantation areas.

mediaAndCommunication.postalServices: India Post provides postal services across the district through head and branch post offices.
mediaAndCommunication.telecommunication: 4G and 5G mobile connectivity is available in most parts of the district.

stateRankings: One of the prominent districts of North-West Bihar
notableAchievements: One of Bihar's leading sugarcane producing districts
Important producer of paddy, wheat and maize
Strong rural economy based on agriculture
developmentIndicators: Improvement in healthcare and educational facilities
Development of agriculture and rural economy
records: Known as one of Bihar's major sugarcane producing districts
Located on the fertile Gangetic plains
Important agricultural district of North Bihar

importantDates: 15 August 1947 – Became part of independent India
additionalInformation: Gopalganj is one of Bihar's important agricultural districts.
The district is famous for sugarcane cultivation and fertile alluvial soil.
Thawe Durga Temple is the district's most prominent religious site.
Agriculture, trade and dairy farming are the backbone of the local economy.
